title: $8.2 Billion From a Card, Not a Seat
description:
Delta got 8.2 billion dollars in 2025. Just from a credit card.

Sources:
- Delta 2025 results: Amex remuneration $8.2B (AltexSoft): https://www.altexsoft.com/travel-industry-news/premium-strategy-works-deltas-2025-revenue-hits-63b/
- Delta cards ~13% of Amex billed business (View from the Wing): https://viewfromthewing.com/amex-pays-delta-3-8-cents-per-dollar-charged-why-banks-pay-more-for-miles-than-you-do/

Figures are from company filings and reporting cited above. Not financial advice.

#shorts #business #finance #howtheymakemoney

scenes.narration: Delta got 8.2 billion dollars in 2025. Just from a credit card.

scenes.narration: Every swipe earns miles. And American Express buys those miles from Delta.
But Delta cards are about 13 percent of all American Express spending.

visual.label: of Amex's worldwide spending is on Delta cards

scenes.narration: And miles don't need fuel. Or pilots. Just a swipe.
